# Submission Pack Structure — TENDER 18-2025/26 (Musina Cloud Helpdesk/Ticketing)

> **PACK-PRESCRIBED STRUCTURE.** Unlike sample 4, this assembly follows the
> official pack's own contents page and attachment rules, quoted from the
> 65-page document. The governing instructions: "THIS BID DOCUMENT MUST BE
> SUBMITTED AS A WHOLE AND ALL FORMS THOROUGHLY COMPLETED, DO NOT REMOVE
> ANY PAGES" (contents page); "The complete Bid Documents obtained must be
> submitted in the same order and no part thereof must be removed or
> omitted" (§3.6); supporting documents "must be attached at the back of
> the official bid document. (i.e. After the Councils price schedule)"
> (§3.9); "INITIAL EVERY PAGE OF THE TENDER DOCUMENT AT THE BOTTOM"
> (page 2). **Retrospective sample — the window closed 11 May 2026.**

## Envelope and logistics

- Sealed envelope "CLEARLY INDICATING THE DESCRIPTION OF THE SERVICE AND
  THE BID NUMBER" — TENDER 18-2025/26 (CRITICAL CRITERIA #4).
- Deposit in the tender box, Reception Office — Room 53 (cnr of Irwin and
  Scholtz), Musina; box open 07:30–16:00 Mondays–Fridays excluding public
  holidays; before **11:00 on 11 May 2026**.
- "Tenders submitted by facsimile, telex, telegram or e-mail WILL NOT BE
  CONSIDERED" (§3.4). Late = "cannot be admitted for consideration".
- Whole document in **ink** (CRITICAL #3); signatures in **black ink**
  (§3.2, Form A instruction); every page initialled at the bottom.

## Master document order (the pack's own contents page, completed in place)

**Part 1 — Invitation to Tender (pages 1–14), completed in place**
1. Cover "DETAILS OF TENDERER": company name, address, contact, email,
   **Bid amount (vat Inclusive) R2,573,750.00**
2. Page-2 checklist ticked (the six documentation lines — the attachments
   themselves go to the back, §3.9)
3. Terms of Reference §4 minimum specification (a)–(eee): compliance
   response per item — "against each requirement it must be indicated
   whether it complies … by inserting Yes or Comply where applicable. Any
   deviation … clearly indicated. Incorrect and misleading information
   furnished by a Bidder will invalidate the tender" (§2.1.7)
4. Pricing schedule (pages 11–12) on the **official grid**: Once-Off /
   Monthly / Annual columns per Year 1–3, per-unit call tariffs, 3-year
   VAT-inclusive total — re-keyed line-for-line from QTN-2026-00341, no
   blank lines ("A definite price must be indicated"; conditional
   discounts disregarded), total reconciled to the cover bid amount to
   the cent

**Part 2 — Information Brochure (15–21) + General Conditions of Contract
(22–33) + Preference Point Explanation (34–39)**: read, initialled every
page, left intact — no returnable fields, but removal breaks §3.6

**Part 3 — Forms to be completed by the Bidder (40–65), in issued order**
5. Form A — Form of Bid: bid number + description, undertaking, signed by
   the bidder **and two witnesses**, signing authority stated (Articles,
   Resolution, Power of Attorney)
6. Form B — Signatory Authorisation + **certified copy of the
   authorisation attached** ("Failure to complete all blank spaces …
   will render the bid liable to rejection")
7. Form C — Declaration of Interest (municipal legacy form): firm
   details, tax/VAT/registration numbers, HDI ownership table with ID
   numbers and gender, management list, subcontracting/JV table, audited
   financials declaration, HDI equity claim, signed + two witnesses
8. MBD 4 — Declaration of Interest ("ANNEXURE C"): full questionnaire
   3.1–3.14, directors table with **State Employee Number** column,
   signed
9. MBD 6.1 — Preference Points Claim (PPR 2022): 80/20 ticked, specific
   goals claimed (HDI 10 claimed on fictional 67% black ownership; women/
   disability/youth 0), company declaration, signed
10. MBD 8 — Past SCM Practices: questions 4.1–4.5 answered No, certified
11. MBD 9 — Certificate of Independent Bid Determination, signed
12. Form D — Local Content and SABS mark certificate: completed (SA-hosted
    services and locally assembled hardware claims conservative — "Care
    should be taken as to the percentages claimed as Council reserves the
    right to demand proof")
13. Form E — OHS Act s37(2) contract: signed on behalf of the bidder
    (municipality countersigns)

**Part 4 — Attachments at the back, "After the Councils price schedule" (§3.9)**
14. TCS PIN letter · certified ID copies of all 3 directors · municipal
    rates statements <3 months for the **company and each director** ·
    certified newest AFS + audited AFS for previous 3 financial years
    (§5.1(i)) · CSD registration report · bank rating letter [A to C]
    <3 months (§5.1(j))
15. Mandatory-requirement documents (§5.1): solution/functionality
    proposal against §4 · tariff cost schedule · project implementation
    plan with milestones · system software description · **three
    contactable references with appointment letters** (12+ month terms) ·
    risk management plan · user operational training plan · support/
    maintenance documentation with 48-hour resolution commitment,
    fault-reporting procedures and technician arrangements
16. Evidence for goals claims: comprehensive CSD report indicating owner
    names, gender, race, age, disability (medical certificate where
    disability is claimed)

## Cross-checks before sealing

- Cover bid amount = pricing-schedule 3-year total = QTN-2026-00341, to
  the cent; per-unit call tariffs entered, none blank.
- Every page initialled at the bottom — including brochure/GCC pages and
  blanks; all signatures black ink; Forms A, B, C and D witnessed (two
  witnesses each where the form provides for them).
- Rates statements and bank rating letter both inside their 3-month
  freshness windows **at closing**.
- All forms are the OFFICIAL issued pages completed in place; the
  generated SDK pack (`03-bid-pack.html`) is the transcription worksheet
  only — this pack's "do not remove any pages" rule makes substitution a
  rejection.
